overall: The AG found the Board properly entered executive session under Purpose 3 to discuss three pending lawsuits and was not required to vote on settlements in open session. No violation; no remedy ordered.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board met in executive session on April 8 without a proper statutory purpose.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Board properly entered executive session under Purpose 3 to discuss these three matters on April 8.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board took votes in executive session, including on settlement agreements, that should have been taken in open session.
allegations.key_passage: The Board was not required, as the complainants suggest, to announce or ratify the settlement agreement in open session as the Board convened in executive session under Purpose 3.
